2. Opposite parties No. 1 and 2 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 274 of 1990 in the Court of the 1st Additional Assistant Judge, Khulna (In-Charge) alleging that plaintiff No.1 is the Chairman of Maheshwaripur Union Parishad, Upazila Koyra, District Khulna. Defendant No. 1 was the Chairman Khulna Zila Parishad. It is alleged that there is no permanent office building of the aforesaid union parishad and no community centre. The authority concerned decided to construct office building of the union parishad and community centre and as such money was sanctioned. The plaintiff being Chairman and other members of the union parishad concerned held meeting and unanimously passed a resolution selecting a site named "Nayani" for construction of Union Parishad Bhavan and Community Centre and defendant No. 10 also gifted some land for that purpose. In the meantime, with some motive and intention the defendants have selected another place named "Gilabari" for the construction of the aforesaid union parishad building and community centre and for that matter a letter was issued. Challenging that letter the plaintiff instituted the present suit for permanent injunction restraining the defendants from constructing the union parishad and community Centre at Gilabari and for declaration of the above letter being illegal and unauthorised. At the time of filing of the suit the plaintiffs filed an application under Order 39 rules 1 and 2 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for temporary injunction. After hearing both the parties and considering the materials on record the learned Assistant Judge concerned rejected the application for temporary injunction by his order dated 28.10.90. 

 Against the aforesaid order of the learned Assistant Judge the plaintiffs preferred appeal before the learned District Judge, Khulna who by his order dated 30.1.91 allowed the appeal setting aside the Judgment and Order of the learned Assistant Judge and granting injunction in favour of the plaintiffs. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and order of the learned District Judge, some of the defendants namely defendant Nos. 1-6 preferred this revisional application and obtained the present Rule. 

 5. In this matter it appears that that Union Parishad concerned selected the place "Nayani as the site for Union Parishad Bhaban and community centre. But the Chairman and members of the Union Parishad found that Zila Parishad concerned sanctioned money and started construction of the building of the aforesaid office and community centre at Gilabari. Challenging that construction of building of the office and community centre the plaintiffs filed the present suit and prayed for injunction. 

 8. Now, from the impugned order and other papers it appears that Union Parishad concerned is only a primary authority to recommend for selection of site of Union Parishad Bhaban and Community Centre. It is not the final authority. So, from the facts and circumstances of the case, it appears that the plaintiffs have no prima facie case to obtain an order of injunction. All the facts were not placed before the learned District Judge at all, if placed the decision might have been otherwise. It is the construction of Union Parishad Bhaban and Community Centre and it is in the absolute domain of the Government to select a site. The government selected Gilabari for the office of Maheshwaripur Union Parishad Bhaban and Community Centre and I am of the view that considering the balance of convenience and inconvenience and on the ground of prima facie case the plaintiffs are not at all entitled to get an order of injunction. Moreover, the plaintiffs are not aggrieved persons and they will not be prejudiced if up office and Community Centre are constructed at Gilabari.
